sources.title: Nemotron 3 Diarization preview by NVIDIA - exploreai.tools
sources.snippet: Nemotron 3 Diarization preview is an official NVIDIA model on Hugging Face for speaker diarization, featuring a voice-activity-detection pipeline. It is tagged with nemo, streaming-sortformer, speaker-tagging, and audio, with associated arXiv papers.

sources.title: Nemotron AI Models | NVIDIA Developer
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for Fast, Specialized Agent Tasks NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is an open 30B MoE model with 3B active parameters for specialized tasks in always-on agents. With NeMo Switchyard, developers can route high-volume execution to Lightning when it's the right fit, while reserving frontier models for complex planning.

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Family of Models
sources.snippet: We announce NVIDIA Nemotron 3, the most efficient family of open models with leading accuracy for agentic AI applications. The Nemotron 3 family consists of three models: Nano, Super, and Ultra.

sources.title: GitHub - NVIDIA-NeMo/Nemotron: Developer Asset Hub for NVIDIA Nemotron ...
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Nemotron is a family of open, high-efficiency multimodal models purpose-built for agentic AI. Model Tiers: Nano — Optimized for edge and PC deployments Lightning — Fast, high-volume task execution for long-running agents Super — Single GPU deployment with highest throughput Ultra — Multi-GPU datacenter applications Nemotron models excel at coding, math, scientific reasoning ...

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
sources.snippet: We are releasing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra - our largest and most capable model yet. Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 55B active 550B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Transformer model that leverages Latent MoE, includes MTP Layers, and was pre-trained in NVFP4.
